doc.brief: The QGraphicsEffect class is the base class for all graphics effects.
doc.index_brief: The base class for all graphics effects

QGraphicsEffect(QObject *parent).brief: Constructs a new QGraphicsEffect instance having the specified *parent*.

QPixmap sourcePixmap(Qt::CoordinateSyste.brief: Returns a pixmap with the source painted into it.

QRectF boundingRect() const.brief: Returns the effective bounding rectangle for this effect, i.e., the bounding rectangle of the source in device coordinates, adjusted by any margins applied by the effect itself.

QRectF boundingRectFor(const QRectF &rec.brief: Returns the effective bounding rectangle for this effect, given the provided *rect* in the device coordinates.

QRectF sourceBoundingRect(Qt::Coordinate.brief: Returns the bounding rectangle of the source mapped to the given *system*.

bool isEnabled() const.brief: This property holds whether the effect is enabled or not.

bool sourceIsPixmap() const.brief: Returns `true` if the source effectively is a pixmap, e.g., a [QGraphicsPixmapItem](xref:qt:QGraphicsPixmapItem).

void draw(QPainter *painter) = 0.brief: This pure virtual function draws the effect and is called whenever the source needs to be drawn.

void drawSource(QPainter *painter).brief: Draws the source directly using the given *painter*.

void enabledChanged(bool enabled).brief: This signal is emitted whenever the effect is enabled or disabled.

void setEnabled(bool enable).brief: This property holds whether the effect is enabled or not.

void sourceChanged(QGraphicsEffect::Chan.brief: This virtual function is called by [QGraphicsEffect](xref:qt:QGraphicsEffect) to notify the effect that the source has changed.

void update().brief: Schedules a redraw of the effect.

void updateBoundingRect().brief: This function notifies the effect framework when the effect's bounding rectangle has changed.

enabled.brief: Whether the effect is enabled or not
